"""Run the checked-in comparison with CPU-load rejection around timing invocations."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,threading,time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('benches/order_workflow').resolve()))
import compare
original=compare.invoke
excluded=[]
started=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
source_before={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for root in ['src','benches/order_workflow','benches/cpp-reference/order_workflow'] for p in Path(root).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.rs','.cpp','.hpp','.py'}}
def busy():
    lines=subprocess.run(['ps','-axo','pid,pcpu,comm'],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.splitlines()[1:]
    found=[]
    for line in lines:
        parts=line.strip().split(None,2)
        if len(parts)!=3 or float(parts[1])<=60: continue
        name=Path(parts[2].strip('()')).name
        if name in {'order_workflow','gd_order_workflow','gd_order_workflow_simd','ps'} or name.startswith('gd_order_workfl'): continue
        found.append(line.strip())
    return found

def guarded(binary,db,workers,stage,samples,index):
    if stage=='verify': return original(binary,db,workers,stage,samples,index)
    while True:
        while busy(): time.sleep(2)
        observations=[];stop=threading.Event()
        def monitor():
            while not stop.is_set():
                processes=busy()
                if processes: observations.append({'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'processes':processes})
                stop.wait(0.5)
        thread=threading.Thread(target=monitor);thread.start()
        try: result=original(binary,db,workers,stage,samples,index)
        finally: stop.set();thread.join()
        if not observations: return result
        result.update(exclusion_reason='Unrelated process exceeded 60% of one CPU during invocation',background_activity=observations)
        excluded.append(result)
        Path('target/order-workflow/rerun-excluded.json').write_text(json.dumps(excluded,indent=2)+'\n')
        print('Excluded and repeating timing invocation:',Path(binary).name,stage,workers,flush=True)
compare.invoke=guarded
compare.main()
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in source_before.items()),'Source changed while measuring'
output=Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--output')+1])
report=json.loads(output.read_text())
report['excluded_measurements']=excluded
report['metadata']['background_cpu_guard']={'started_utc':started,'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'threshold_percent_of_one_cpu':60,'poll_interval_seconds':0.5,'method':'Wait before timing while unrelated CPU activity exceeds threshold; reject and repeat the entire invocation if observed during warmup or samples. Exclude benchmark processes. Use unchanged compare.invoke and drivers; no instrumentation or sanitizers in measured programs.','excluded_invocations':len(excluded),'controller_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'controller_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
report['metadata']['gd_rs_source_state']='Measured current worktree; gd_rs_revision is the base revision and source_sha256 identifies implementation files'
output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Guarded comparison completed; source fingerprints unchanged.',flush=True)
